links.comparator_used: Original ChatGPT without integrated clinical practice guidelines (generic prompt relying on built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Accuracy and clarity of COVID-19 outpatient treatment decision responses, as rated by two pulmonary/critical care physicians
links.effect: Increased accuracy and clarity versus original ChatGPT; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Hallucination was only moderate in ChatGPT-CARE. The tool also combined guideline in-context learning with chain-of-thought prompting, so the guideline effect is not isolated.
links.quote: The results indicate that ChatGPT-CARE offers increased accuracy and clarity, with moderate hallucination, compared to the original ChatGPT.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with clinical practice guidelines
